title: Hand Over Your Weapon
summary: Fight the Divine Chariot Azazel in his Lair. If you hand him a sword or axe he lets you live and you'll have to come back. Kill him and take his Staff of Manipulation.

goals.name: Staff of Manipulation (from his barrel)
goals.say: 'I'm sorry I failed to meet your expectations, my lord...' He was not talking to you. 'God.' You killed him. Or half of him.
